description: Acceptance eval set for /legal-timeline (spec §8). Test documents in legal-briefing-workspace/timeline-testdocs/ contain one planned date conflict (delivery 3.3 vs 10.3.2024), one planned contested event (defect at delivery), one multilingual duplicate (DE contract + FR letter), a 48-day documentation gap (15.1 → 3.3.2024), and one notification event feeding compute_deadlines (Berufung, canton ZH).

evals.expected_output: Every event in events.json has a non-empty source array with doc + locus. No event without provenance appears in any output. The render script validate step passes.

evals.prompt: Check how the delivery event is represented in the timeline.
evals.expected_output: The delivery event carries a conflicts array with BOTH dates: 2024-03-03 (01-vertrag, Ziff. 4.1) and 2024-03-10 (02-brief, p. 1). The discrepancy is explicitly flagged in timeline.md and timeline.html; neither date is silently picked.

evals.prompt: Check the status of the defect-at-delivery assertion.
evals.expected_output: Status is 'contested' with attribution recording that Meier alleges the machine was defective at delivery and Muster AG disputes it.

evals.prompt: Check how the DE contract and FR letter delivery references are merged.
evals.expected_output: One single delivery event with TWO sources (01-vertrag Ziff. 4.1 and 02-brief p. 1) — not two separate events.

evals.prompt: Check whether evidentiary gaps are flagged.
evals.expected_output: The period 2024-01-15 → 2024-03-03 (48 days with no documented events) is flagged as an evidentiary gap in all outputs (>= 30 day rule).

evals.prompt: Run /legal-timeline --deadlines --canton=ZH and check the Berufung marker.
evals.expected_output: A procedural deadline marker anchored to the notification event (15.4.2024) exists, computed via compute_deadlines (zpo_berufung_30, canton ZH): due 2024-05-15, labelled with its basis (Art. 311 Abs. 1 ZPO).
timeline.md (table), timeline.html (interactive, self-contained, status colour coding), and timeline.docx all exist under bcc-output/timeline/.

evals.prompt: Inject an event without source into events.json and run the render script validate step.
evals.expected_output: Validation fails and refuses to render: the unsourced event is reported as rejected. No output is produced with the unsourced event.
